controls.description: A user-scoped order read returns only the orders of the actor.
A user-scoped invoice read returns only the invoices of the actor, whatever the id type.
A user-scoped note read returns only the notes of the actor.
Internal note fields never leave the store, even on a trusted service read.
The account deletion capability is neither registered nor declared.
Refunds and partner notifications are neither registered nor declared.
The output sink escapes markup and removes control characters.

frameworks.requirement: Adapter over the Anthropic SDK with an in-memory test transport.
Adapter over the OpenAI Agents SDK runner with a scripted custom model and tracing disabled.
Adapter over a compiled LangGraph graph with a scripted model node and fresh state per case.
MCP transport and proxy in Gazua, then the TypeScript stdio server of the shared domain.

checks.description: The canary is detected by its native signal; reports keep it only as a whole value.
gazua run --tools agrees with the programmatic run on exit code, states and findings.
Zero real calls of tools that are not safe, nested and async paths included; no network or credential read.
The hardened target still serves the legitimate requests of its own users.
Payloads stay inert in the generated HTML report, under its content security policy.
Hypothesis properties of verdicts over evidence, retries and correlation.
Bounded fuzzing of the YAML data profile.
